# Vendored: dashersw/liquid-glass-js (MIT)

Source: https://github.com/dashersw/liquid-glass-js — MIT, © 2025 Armagan Amcalar.
Vendored because it is not published to npm. The npm package named
`liquid-glass-js` is a DIFFERENT author's project — do not install it.

Copy these files into each site rather than importing across projects, so every
site stays standalone. Keep LICENSE alongside them.

Defines globals `Container` and `Button` (Button extends Container).
Requires html2canvas to sample the page behind the glass.
See ../../docs/EFFECTS-INTEGRATION.md for the React wrapper guidance.
